changelog:
KryonOS 1.1.0: base migrada para ESP-IDF 6.1 (sem Arduino); multi-placa SmartDisplay S3 + Cheap Yellow Display; novo runtime de touch GT911; servidor web sobre esp_http_server com upload e OTA pelo navegador; Net.* HTTP para apps.
- Over-the-air firmware updates (Settings > System Updates > INSTALL)
- Web firmware upload via file manager (/update)
- Captive portal WiFi setup
- Net.* HTTP API for JS apps
- Settings PIN lock
- Brightness control (SmartDisplay)
guide: Updates install directly on the device: open Settings > System Updates and tap INSTALL. Alternatively open the web file manager and use Firmware Update.
